rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a 3AB blastocyst: expanded cavity, thinned zona, compact ICM, and looser TE. However, it adds specific positional/detail claims from the image and slightly overstates TE as a cohesive layer despite the lab description of few cells/loose epithelium.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, BMI, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a clear link from embryo grade and patient factors to prognosis. Minor issues include somewhat speculative attribution of TE grade to sperm quality and precise percentage adjustments that are not firmly evidence-based.

Core recommendations such as proceeding with single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but several adjuncts are weakly supported or not routinely recommended (embryo glue, low-dose aspirin, routine karyotype/thrombophilia workup, ERA/assisted hatching suggestions).

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET and follow-up options. Some suggestions are practical, though a few are more speculative than standard-of-care.
